name: Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan - Considérant E - Am 10
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: 1. Highlights the fact that the RRF is an unprecedented instrument of solidarity in the light of two unprecedented crises and a cornerstone of the NGEU instrument, ending in 2026; highlights the stabilising effect of the RRF for Member States at a time of great economic uncertainty, as it mitigates negative economic and social consequences and supports governments by contributing to the implementation of the European Pillar of Social Rights; highlights, furthermore, that in the context of the current global geopolitical situation, it is essential to use RRF also as an instrument to develop and strengthen the EU’s security and defence capabilities;
